title: awesomeTMC: Triplet Markov Chains for Fast Optimal Filtering in Gaussian Markov Switching Systems
description:
awesomeTMC (formerly exactIMM) is a Python library for exact and fast optimal filtering in Gaussian Markov switching systems modelled as triplet Markov chains. It implements the exact linear-time filters of the CGOMSM1 (C = 0) and CGOMSM2 (AB constraint) families, including a known exogenous input; exact O(N K^2) fixed-interval smoothers on their exactness domains; reference filters (exact K^N mixture filter, IMM, GPB2, Rao-Blackwellized particle filter); tools that test whether a model lies in the exactness domain of each filter (block test of the AB constraint, cross-annihilation condition of GPB2); supervised and semi-supervised (Baum-Welch EM) parameter estimation; an optional PyQt6 interface; and the scripts that reproduce the experiments of the companion papers.

Install from PyPI with pip install awesomeTMC (Python 3.14); the package is imported as awesometmc. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.
